meta.promptText: Which moisturizer should I buy for dry skin in Indian winters?

response.text:
For **dry skin in Indian winters**, I’d prioritize a **rich, fragrance-free cream with ceramides + humectants (glycerin/hyaluronic acid)**. Winter dryness is mainly about moisture loss and a weakened skin barrier, so a cream generally works better than a lightweight gel. [www.pingmedoc.com](https://www.pingmedoc.com/pharmacy/buying-guides/best-moisturizer-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My picks

### [CeraVe Moisturising Cream]()
*₹422*

### [Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser]()
*₹265*

### [Minimalist Ceramide Barrier Repair Moisturizing Cream]()
*₹540*

### [Dot & Key Ceramides & Hyaluronic Barrier Repair Moisturizer]()
*₹250*

**🥇 Best overall for very dry skin: CeraVe Moisturising Cream**  
It has **3 ceramides + hyaluronic acid**, is fragrance-free, and is designed for dry-to-very-dry skin. It's particularly good if your skin gets flaky or tight in winter. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/10-best-barrier-repair-creams-for-indian-winters-that-truly-heal-dry-skin-10792239?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**💰 Best value: Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser**  
A good Indian option if you want ceramides and hyaluronic acid without spending much.

**🌙 If your skin is extremely dry:** go for a thicker cream and apply it to **slightly damp skin**, especially after bathing. This helps trap water in the skin. [www.pingmedoc.com](https://www.pingmedoc.com/pharmacy/buying-guides/best-moisturizer-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
